behaviors.description: Select competing test/master app branches through remote defaults.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent query branches with distinct refs and commits.
behaviors.expected: Adding a test default selects test; modifying it to master selects master without an explicit branch in either install.

behaviors.description: Add a disabled remote and subsequently enable it.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A repository and empty user installation.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary enumeration omits the remote, show-disabled exposes its disabled property, and enabling permits exact A installation.

behaviors.description: Apply a ref filter while adding a remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app/runtime repository and a runtime-only filter.
behaviors.expected: Only the runtime is advertised and installable; clearing the filter permits the exact app commit.

behaviors.description: Contrast default verification with explicitly disabled verification on remote-add.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unsigned A repository and no installed refs.
behaviors.expected: Default verification rejects unsigned content during remote addition or installation; the explicitly unchecked remote installs exact app/runtime commits.

behaviors.description: Import a signing key while adding a remote and retain signature verification.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent signed and unsigned repositories plus the trusted public key.
behaviors.expected: Missing-key installation fails; the imported key permits exact signed commits; the same trusted remote still rejects unsigned content.

mappings.rationale: Branchless installs select exact competing refs before and after changing the default.

surface_assertions.rationale: The added test default selects test instead of the competing master branch.
Changing the default to master changes the installed ref from test to master.

mappings.rationale: The persisted disabled property changes public enumeration before a successful enabled control.

surface_assertions.rationale: The remote is hidden from ordinary enumeration but remains explicitly queryable as disabled.

mappings.rationale: Ref membership and installability differ before and after filter removal.

surface_assertions.rationale: The configured filter restricts both advertised refs and installation resolution.

mappings.rationale: Identical unsigned input fails under default verification and succeeds only with verification disabled.

surface_assertions.rationale: Unsigned commits become installable with the explicit no-verification option.

mappings.rationale: Signed installs depend on the imported key while unsigned installs remain rejected.

surface_assertions.rationale: Importing the independent public key permits verified installation without accepting unsigned content.
